1. Purpose

Every electronic engagement file at Example & Associates uses one naming pattern, so that a reviewer can find a file without opening it.

2. Pattern

Client code, financial year, area code and a running number, joined by hyphens: for example NWT-FY26-INV-003.

Questions the engagement team cannot settle within two working days go to the firm's technical desk.

2. How

  • Log the question in the AUDQ query log.
  • Attach the relevant working papers.
  • The desk replies within five working days.
